description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CoStar Group is hiring a Software Engineer I for BizBuySell, its online business-for-sale marketplace. The role focuses on building and improving high-performance web experiences that help buyers and sellers navigate the process of buying and selling businesses.
Full-stack web engineer building accessible, high-traffic applications and architecting reusable product features

Responsibilities:
• ​Design, develop, and support high-traffic, real-time web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC on the backend and Angular, Vue, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript on the frontend, ensuring they are performant, maintainable, and reusable
• Build responsive, accessible (WCAG-compliant) interfaces that work reliably across browsers and devices
• Lead in establishing architectural best practices and mentor junior team members
• Analyze technical requirements and architect new components and web pages
• Implement product features, refine specifications, and continuously improve code quality
• Apply software design patterns and best practices for building reusable and maintainable code
• Participate in code reviews, source control management, build automation, and testing processes
• Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver solutions from concept to implementation
• Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and business partners on product design, feature development and delivery
• Gain a deep understanding of the company's business domain and products

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited, not-for-profit, in-person University or College
• A track record of commitment to prior employers
• Strong working knowledge of modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript)
• Experience with a modern SPA framework (Angular, Vue, etc.) and TypeScript
• Proven ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Experience working in an Agile development environment
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position

Preferred:
• Experience building and deploying web applications to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure)
• Experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL)
• Experience with software testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Mocha)
• Deep understanding of software design patterns and principles
• Experience in microservices architectures
• Experience mentoring junior developers
• Effective use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) to accelerate delivery while maintaining strong code quality and architectural judgment
